title: Design coco-pilot: QFD as decision logic for conflict-aware human–LLM collaborative product conceptual design

context_summary: The paper proposes a framework called Design Coco-pilot that integrates QFD into human-LLM collaborative conceptual design to address design conflicts. It applies the framework to develop an intelligent flight assistant and evaluates it with licensed pilots and aviation experts.

chains.claim_quote: To assess relative performance, we compared three LLM-based co-design paradigms: (i) the proposed design CocoPilot; (ii) a multi-agent design pipeline without QFD integra- tion, in which multiple domain-specific LLM agents collaboratively generated concepts, with expert roles aligned to those defined in the design CocoPilot framework for con- sistency; and (iii) a single-agent chain-of-thought baseline, where a single LLM produced outputs through step-by-step reasoning under one prompt.
